power: AC; low power mode off when checked
thermal: no thermal/performance warning recorded at calibration check; continuous temperature NOT_MEASURED
method: Phase windows aligned to report receipt; process samples have approximately one-second alignment uncertainty. Candidate RSS sums are not physical/exclusive memory. CPU100%=one core.
coverage_gate: >=95% completed eligible effects in separate single/navigation cohorts
latency: synthetic action scheduled within rAF; callback time to next rAF, not physical/manual input latency
frame_metric: rAF callback interval, not physical presentation, paint or GPU time
earlier_calibrations: excluded, including all invalid schedules and earlier binary hashes
